groups.anti_bias: attack-vector (precedent and ownership vs non-vacuity and reproducibility vs definitional-soundness and non-collapse)

predicted_disagreements.statement: Agent 0 attacks through precedent and current ownership while agent 1 attacks through non-vacuity and reproducibility on the attack-vector axis; an owner-backed rule without a reproduced witness, or a reproduced heuristic without an owner, would be exposed by the other.
